objective: Preregistered factorial falsification of fixed-width temporal recognition across genuine per-tick observation noise, unseen order perturbations and disjoint seeds.
defect_control: W-R15's development jitter used coefficient 3*t modulo 3, yielding no tick variation; retain W-R15 as observed first-use result but do not infer that its development noise was time-varying. R16 uses multiplier 11 coprime to moduli 3/5/7.
frozen_generator: Base W-R11 16x4 synthetic sequence. Candidate copies the original with global channel shift and independent deterministic bounded per-tick/channel noise ((11*t+7*channel+3*entity+seed) mod (2*amp+1))-amp. Compare original with candidate; negatives reorder only the candidate's last 15 observations and retain identical candidate first observation and multiset as matched positives.
learning: Fixed 16 real weights plus bias per arm, zero init, 32 full ordered passes and learning rate 0.1. Four candidate representations each see the exact same 16 seeds x 9 entities x 3 train families x 2 train noise x 2 labels =1728 examples. No heldout model selection, no recalibration.
analysis: Report 9 heldout cells x four arms with per-seed confusion and all counts, plus aggregate. STRONG_FAMILY_TRANSFER iff one order-sensitive arm attains >=0.85 accuracy in EVERY heldout cell, unordered histogram has <=0.60 aggregate accuracy; PARTIAL if some order-sensitive arm exceeds unordered aggregate but does not meet strict condition; NEGATIVE otherwise. Always report strata including any worse-than-random results. Evaluate control truth labels.
controls: Train noise varies by timestep for all amplitudes and is different from previous bug
match positive and negative first row/multiset per seed entity amplitude
at least one nonzero feature for order-sensitive negative
no access to heldout calibration or updates
first-use artifact uploaded before final integration full regression
claim_limit: Finite supervised toy sequence recognition; no claim of general learning, real language reasoning, or deployment; no accepted ref mutation.
